lines.text: That coat looks like old movies!
That coat is giving old movie star.

data.define: Used to say that something reminds you of a style or mood.

example.text: That coat is giving old movie star.

misuse.text: Don't say 'it's giving' to a job interviewer.

data.l1_hook: O ceket eski filmlere benziyor! ("it's giving")
data.l1_ex: O ceket "it's giving" eski film yıldızı gibi.
